note.vi: Nguồn: World Bank, tỷ giá chính thức bình quân năm (PA.NUS.FCRF). Trước 1999 là franc Pháp (FRF) trên USD, quy đổi sang EUR theo tỷ giá chuyển đổi không thể đảo ngược 6,55957 FRF = 1 EUR (áp dụng từ 1/1/1999). Từ 1999 là tỷ giá EUR/USD thực tế (đồng euro là đơn vị kế toán từ 1999, tiền giấy/xu lưu hành từ 2002).
note.en: Source: World Bank official exchange rate, period average (PA.NUS.FCRF). Pre-1999 figures are French franc (FRF) per USD, converted to EUR at the irrevocable rate of 6.55957 FRF = 1 EUR (fixed 1 Jan 1999). From 1999 onward these are actual EUR/USD rates (the euro was the accounting currency from 1999; notes and coins circulated from 2002).

name.vi: SMIC (lương tối thiểu liên ngành) theo giờ

note.vi: SMIC la luong toi thieu lien nganh hop phap duy nhat tai Phap, ap dung cho moi nganh. Gia tri la muc brut gio co hieu luc tai ngay duoc ghi chu (thuong thay doi giua nam truoc 2010, tu 2010 chi dieu chinh 1/1 hang nam, co them dieu chinh dot xuat khi lam phat cao). Truoc 1999 la franc, quy doi theo ty gia khong the dao nguoc 6,55957 FRF = 1 EUR.
note.en: The SMIC is France's single statutory minimum wage covering all sectors. Values are the gross hourly rate in force on the noted date (revaluations happened mid-year before 2010; since 2010 the main revaluation is 1 January, with extra ad-hoc bumps during high inflation). Pre-1999 figures are francs, converted at the irrevocable rate of 6.55957 FRF = 1 EUR.

name.vi: Gia vang (LBMA, cuoi nam) theo gram

note.vi: Gia vang giao ngay LBMA (London) cuoi nam, quy doi sang EUR theo ty gia cuoi nam cung ngay (truoc 1999 dung franc Phap quy doi theo ty gia khong the dao nguoc 6,55957 FRF = 1 EUR). Day la gia ban buon London, khong phai gia ban le tai Phap (gia ban le co them thue/phi gia cong).
note.en: LBMA London spot gold price at year-end, converted to EUR at the same-day year-end exchange rate (pre-1999 figures use the French franc converted at the irrevocable rate of 6.55957 FRF = 1 EUR). This is the London wholesale price, not the French retail price (retail adds dealer premiums/fabrication fees).

note.vi: Gia ban le trung binh nam, da bao gom thue (TTC). note.en: Average annual retail price, tax-included (TTC). The reference petrol grade changes over time as the market evolved (ordinary leaded petrol pre-1990s, then SP98, then SP95/SP95-E10 as the most common grade today), so the series is not a single uniform product throughout - see per-point notes. Pre-1999 figures are francs, converted at 6.55957 FRF = 1 EUR.

name.vi: Gia Big Mac (trung binh khu vuc dong Euro)

note.vi: The Economist cong bo mot muc gia Big Mac duy nhat cho ca khu vuc dong Euro (ma 'EUZ' trong du lieu goc), khong tach rieng tung nuoc; do do gia nay dai dien cho ca Phap va cac nuoc dong Euro khac, khong phai gia nieu yet rieng tai Phap (gia thuc te tai Phap co the chenh lech vai %). Diem moi nam lay tu lan khao sat dau nam (thang 1 hoac 4).
note.en: The Economist publishes a single Big Mac price for the whole euro area ('EUZ' in the raw dataset), not broken out by country; so this price represents the euro area including France, not a France-specific menu price (actual French prices can differ by a few percent). One point per year taken from the first survey wave of that year (January or April).

series.note: Premiere annee de l'indice Big Mac publie en continu (donnees semestrielles, valeur de janvier/avril retenue)

note.vi: Gia ban le trung binh toan quoc tai tiem banh, quy ve 1 baguette 250g. 1986-1991 la uoc tinh/quy doi tu franc (Insee chi co chuoi gia chinh thuc tu 1992); 2023-2024 lay tu khao sat UFC-Que Choisir thay the cho chuoi Insee da ngung.
note.en: Average national bakery retail price, normalised to a 250g baguette. 1986-1991 are franc-based estimates/conversions (Insee's official series only starts in 1992); 2023-2024 come from the UFC-Que Choisir survey that replaced the discontinued Insee series.
